note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), who transcribed the description of Thakur and Chatterjee (1974); the original is in English, soldier and worker known, alate unknown; the soldier body length is given in the original as '5.3.5', and the worker head length and maximum width as '0.70-0..80' and '0.80-0.95', all not recorded because of OCR defects or double dots; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, posterior margin undulate, without a V-shaped suture, fontanelle indistinct, head width/head length ratio 0.74; mandibles thick, sickle-shaped, base very wide, about half the head length, each with a distinct pointed tooth situated near the apical third; postmentum club-shaped, waist below the middle; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a weak median notch, wider than long. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; mandibles light brown, paler at the base; body white. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, head length to mandible base 1.75 mm, maximum width 1.30 mm, width/length ratio 0.74; sides nearly parallel, posterior margin undulate; without a V-shaped suture. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 nearly equal in length, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat, hairy, elliptical; anteclypeus transparent, hairless, strip-like. Mandibles thick, sickle-shaped, base very wide; about half the head length, length 0.88 mm, mandible length/head length ratio 0.50; each with a distinct pointed tooth situated near the apical third, tooth distance from apex/mandible length ratio 0.27. Postmentum club-shaped, waist below the middle; length 1.0 mm, maximum width 0.45 mm, waist width 0.25 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a weak notch in the middle, wider than long; length 0.43 mm, width 0.70 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, antennae, labrum and thorax pale yellow; abdomen greyish owing to gut contents showing through. Head and body with numerous hairs. Body length 4.00–4.70 mm. Head subcircular; without a V-shaped suture. Fontanelle plate white, transparent, forming a circular spot 0.10 mm in diameter, situated mid-dorsally. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Mandibles of the generic type. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25–0.30 mm, maximum width 0.50–0.58 mm.
